scripts.build: npm run core:build && npm run build:pack && npm --workspace launcher run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace launcher test && node --test kubejs-custom/test_items.cjs kubejs-custom/tests/*.test.cjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s resourcepacks -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s questbook-custom/tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s client-pack -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s server-ops/tests -p "test_*.py" && python3 sunrin-core/test-domain.py
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm --workspace launcher run package:mac
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm --workspace launcher run package:win
scripts.build:pack: python3 build-scripts/build-resources.py && python3 build-scripts/build-update.py --repo mingyu1715/sunrin-valley --min-launcher-version 1.1.3 --bundle-output release/bundled
